title: Single Assign Class – Archived Lesson Allocation – Existing Class Member – Student Excluded from New Class Lesson
description: AC-2 / AC-5 - Decision Table: A Class Member retained under an archived Lesson Allocation is excluded from class auto-assignment.
preconditions:
- HQ or CM Staff is logged in to Salesforce.
- Today is 2026-05-20 in the organisation time zone.
- Class A belongs to Course Math 101 at Location Tokyo HQ.
- Student A has one active Lesson Allocation for Math 101 from 2026-05-01 through 2026-12-31.
- Student A has one Class A membership from 2026-05-01 through 2026-12-31.
- No Class A lesson exists on 2026-05-21.
steps_actions:
1. "HQ or CM Staff removes every Student Package Order for Student A's Math 101 allocation and waits for allocation processing to finish"
2. "HQ or CM Staff creates a one-time Group lesson for Class A on 2026-05-21"
3. "HQ or CM Staff waits for class auto-assignment to finish"
4. "HQ or CM Staff opens the new lesson's Student Sessions list"
steps_result:
1. "Student A's Lesson Allocation is archived, while the existing Class A membership keeps its original dates and becomes archived"
2. "The new lesson is created"
3. "Class auto-assignment finishes without an error"
4. "Student A is absent from the list because the retained Class A membership is archived"
steps_data:
1. "today = 2026-05-20; allocation_start = 2026-05-01; allocation_end = 2026-12-31; class_start = 2026-05-01; class_end = 2026-12-31"
2. "lesson_date = 2026-05-21"
3. "class = Class A"
4. "Student A allocation archived -> class member excluded"

- Class A belongs to Course Math 101 at Location Tokyo HQ.
- Student A has one active Lesson Allocation and one active Class A membership, both valid from 2026-05-01 through 2026-12-31.

steps_result:

2. "The lesson is created"
3. "Student A is absent; the archive state is not treated as active because its UTC date is the prior calendar day"

2. "lesson_start = 2026-05-20 09:00 JST (= 2026-05-20 00:00 UTC)"
